calibration_source: closures from the Falkner-Skan family; no fitted constant

calibration_source: standard value 0.09; with C_eps2 it fixes Tu(x) from the rig's integral length scale, and neither is fitted here

role: k-epsilon constant in the free-stream turbulence decay
calibration_source: standard value 1.92; sets the decay exponent of isotropic grid turbulence

calibration_source: True is the model; False is the 'no bubble closure' ablation

role: shape factor in the dead-air momentum equation follows the reverse-flow profile (ablation path only)

role: Thwaites parameter at laminar separation
calibration_source: Thwaites (1949) published value; not fitted

calibration_source: superseded by the bubble closure; reachable only with bubble=False

calibration_source: discretisation parameter; onset moves <0.2% over 24-64

role: separate amplification threshold for the crossflow branch (ablation path only)
